title.zh: 避开对手就要拿到的补给

brief.zh: 计算两件补给各自的领先量。看机器人怎样舍近求远，走向更有把握的补给。
brief.en: Calculate the margin for two supplies. Watch the robot take the route toward the more promising one.

concept.zh: 用所有对手的位置重新估算目标
concept.en: Estimate a target using the positions of every rival

hints.zh: 负数表示至少一个对手比你近。
hints.en: A negative margin means at least one rival is closer.

title.zh: 右侧有人更近，先去左侧
title.en: A rival is closer on the right, so go left
